landmarks.name: Chicago Riverwalk Trail
landmarks.fact: The Chicago Riverwalk is an open waterfront path running along the south bank of the Chicago River.

landmarks.name: Chicago Lakefront Trail
landmarks.fact: The Chicago Lakefront Trail is a scenic 18.5-mile path stretching along the shores of Lake Michigan.

landmarks.name: Michigan Avenue
landmarks.fact: Michigan Avenue is a famous street in Chicago, home to historic architecture and the Magnificent Mile shopping area.

landmarks.name: Wabash Avenue
landmarks.fact: Wabash Avenue is a major street in downtown Chicago, famously running beneath the iconic elevated train tracks.

landmarks.name: Chicago Theatre
landmarks.fact: The Chicago Theatre is an iconic landmark built in 1921, famous for its legendary marquee sign on State Street.

landmarks.name: Butler Field
landmarks.fact: Butler Field is a spacious green lawn in Grant Park used for outdoor sports, festivals, and community gatherings.

landmarks.name: North Rose Garden
landmarks.fact: The North Rose Garden in Grant Park features manicured flower beds and scenic views of the Chicago skyline.

landmarks.name: Buckingham Fountain
landmarks.fact: Buckingham Fountain is a landmark in Grant Park, recognized as one of the largest fountains in the world.

landmarks.name: Grant Park
landmarks.fact: Grant Park is a prominent 319-acre urban park located in the heart of downtown Chicago along Lake Michigan.
